name: Owl Insight Analytics
author: Talha Zahid

sections.description:
View your website analytics inside WordPress

Owl Insight Analytics brings reporting data for the website where it is installed into a focused dashboard inside WordPress admin. Connect the site’s GA4 property to review visitors, sessions, page views, engagement, traffic channels, referral sources, top pages, countries, devices, browsers, operating systems, screen sizes, and other available metrics without leaving WordPress.

Shape the dashboard around the questions you actually ask. Add or remove metric widgets, rearrange their placement, choose reporting dates, compare performance, and open detailed widget reports. Depending on your Owl Insight plan, you can also generate AI-assisted summaries, export reports, and create share links.

Owl Insight Analytics is a Google Analytics alternative for people who want the value of GA4 without the complexity of navigating GA4 every day.

It uses the GA4 data you already collect. There is no new visitor-tracking script to install, no second analytics system to maintain, and no need to rebuild your analytics setup.

See the live dashboard demo or learn why Owl Insight is a simpler GA4 reporting alternative.

A practical Google Analytics alternative

Many Google Analytics alternatives require you to replace your tracking script and start collecting data in a separate platform. Owl Insight takes a different approach: GA4 continues collecting and storing your analytics data, while Owl Insight gives you a simpler way to view and use it.

That means you can keep your existing history, Google integrations, and measurement setup while using a cleaner daily analytics workflow. Owl Insight is an alternative to the GA4 reporting experience, not an alternative tracking script.

Choose Owl Insight when you want:

  • One focused dashboard instead of moving through multiple GA4 report areas.
  • A quick answer to what changed, where visitors came from, and which content performed.
  • A customizable layout built around the metrics your team actually reviews.
  • Clear reports that are easier to share with clients and colleagues.
  • The benefits of a simple analytics tool without replacing your current Google Analytics implementation.

Understand the website at a glance

GA4 is a powerful analytics platform, but finding the answer to a routine website question can involve several reports and configuration screens. Owl Insight brings the most useful signals into one focused view so founders, marketers, agencies, product teams, and website owners can understand performance faster.

Depending on the data available in your connected GA4 property, your dashboard can show:

  • Active users, sessions, page views, engagement, and visit duration.
  • Traffic trends and acquisition channels.
  • Top pages and referral sources.
  • Countries, devices, browsers, operating systems, and screen sizes.
  • A customizable widget layout for the website connected to WordPress.
  • AI-assisted summaries, sharing, and exports when available for your Owl Insight plan.

How it works

  1. Activate the plugin and open Owl Insight in WordPress admin.
  2. Sign in with a Google account that can read this website’s GA4 property.
  3. Grant read-only Google Analytics access.
  4. Owl Insight matches the WordPress site URL to the corresponding GA4 web data stream.
  5. Review the site’s dashboard without leaving WordPress admin.

The plugin is intentionally focused on the WordPress website where it is installed. It does not include multi-property tabs or a property switcher. This keeps the experience relevant to the current site.

Simpler reporting, the same GA4 data

Your current Google Analytics implementation continues collecting data as before. Owl Insight changes the reporting workflow, not the underlying measurement. The plugin adds no front-end output and does not change your public website’s tracking configuration.

Privacy and access

  • Google Analytics access is read-only.
  • Google access and refresh tokens are handled by Owl Insight and are not stored in WordPress.
  • WordPress stores only an encrypted, site-scoped Owl Insight connection token.
  • Only logged-in WordPress users with the manage_options capability can connect, view, or disconnect the dashboard.
  • The plugin does not add cookies, tracking scripts, or visitor-facing output.

Privacy and data handling

This plugin communicates with https://owlinsight.dev only after an administrator chooses “Sign in with Google” and completes the connection.

The service is required to authenticate the administrator with Google, obtain read-only access to Google Analytics, match the WordPress site URL to a GA4 web data stream, and return analytics dashboard data. During connection and dashboard use, the WordPress site URL, a short-lived authorization code, a site-scoped Owl Insight access token, requested date ranges, widget identifiers, and analytics responses are exchanged with Owl Insight. Google authentication data and Google API tokens are handled by Owl Insight and are not stored by this WordPress plugin.

  • Owl Insight privacy policy
  • Owl Insight terms
  • Google privacy policy
  • Google API Services User Data Policy

Developer information

The complete human-readable dashboard code is included in source/src. The reproducible npm project and build directions are in source/README.md. Dependency licenses are documented in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt.
sections.installation:
1. Install “Owl Insight Analytics” from the WordPress plugin directory, or upload the owl-insight-analytics folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open Owl Insight in the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Select Sign in with Google and choose an account that can read this site’s GA4 property.
  5. Approve read-only Google Analytics access. Owl Insight will match the property by its web-stream URL.

The WordPress site and admin URL must use HTTPS, except for local development on localhost or 127.0.0.1. The server must support OpenSSL with AES-256-GCM.
sections.faq:
Is Owl Insight a Google Analytics alternative?

Yes. Owl Insight is an alternative to the standard Google Analytics reporting experience. It gives you a simpler, focused dashboard for the GA4 data your website already collects. Unlike analytics alternatives that require a new tracking script, Owl Insight lets you keep GA4 as the data source.

Does Owl Insight replace GA4 tracking?

No. Owl Insight replaces the complexity of the everyday reporting workflow, not the tracking implementation. GA4 continues collecting and storing your data, so you keep your existing history and setup.

Why choose Owl Insight instead of viewing reports directly in GA4?

Owl Insight is designed for fast, routine decisions. It gathers important website metrics in one customizable dashboard, makes reports easier to scan and share, and reduces the time spent moving between GA4 report areas.

How is Owl Insight different from other Google Analytics alternatives?

Many alternatives collect data with their own tracking script and create a separate analytics history. Owl Insight uses the GA4 property you already have. You sign in, connect the matching property, and get a simpler view without replacing code or starting again.

Do I need to install a new tracking code?

No. The plugin does not add tracking code, scripts, cookies, or front-end output. Your existing Google Analytics setup continues working normally.

Do I need an existing GA4 property?

Yes. The website must already have a GA4 property and web data stream, and the Google account you choose must have permission to read it.

How does Owl Insight choose the correct property?

Owl Insight compares the current WordPress site URL with the website URL configured for accessible GA4 web data streams. The plugin is single-site by design, so there is no multi-property selector inside WordPress.

What Google permissions does Owl Insight request?

Owl Insight requests read-only Google Analytics access. It cannot edit your property, change tracking settings, or modify analytics data.

Are my Google tokens stored in WordPress?

No. Google tokens are handled by the Owl Insight service and are not sent to or stored by this WordPress plugin. WordPress stores only an encrypted, site-scoped Owl Insight access token.

Who can connect or view the dashboard?

Only logged-in WordPress users with the manage_options capability, which is normally limited to administrators.

Does the plugin require the Owl Insight service?

Yes. Owl Insight is a hosted reporting service. The service performs Google authentication, property matching, and analytics reporting. A connected dashboard contacts Owl Insight when an authorized administrator opens or refreshes it.

Can I see the dashboard before connecting my website?

Yes. Visit the interactive Owl Insight demo to explore the dashboard without connecting your website.

Are all dashboard features free?

Core availability and features can depend on your current Owl Insight plan. The connection screen and Owl Insight website show the options available to your account.
